BusinessModel: JNK India makes fired heaters, cracking furnaces, flares and incinerators for refineries, petrochemical and fertiliser plants. It sells made-to-order heating equipment projects to clients like Reliance and ADNOC.
RevenueStreams: Heating equipment ~76% of FY25 order inflow; process plants ~15%; flares/incinerators ~9%; FY25 consolidated revenue Rs 838 crore
Expenses: Raw material steel and fabrication dominate; detailed split data not found
TAM: Global heat-exchanger and process-fired-heater market driven by refinery and petrochem capex in India and Middle East; exact size data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: Order-book execution on heating equipment projects (order book ~Rs 1,220 crore end-March 2025); steel raw material costs and delays; export orders from ADNOC and Reliance cracking furnace order

BusinessModel: Ratnaveer makes stainless-steel washers, fasteners, sheets and solar mounting frames across five Gujarat plants. It sells to Indian industry and exports worldwide, leading India in SS washer exports.
RevenueStreams: SS washers and precision fasteners (largest); SS sheets; solar mounting frames/clamps; FY25 revenue Rs 892 crore; CCL copper clad laminates planned from Nov 2026
Expenses: SS scrap and skelp raw material dominates (typical 60-70% for such processors); detailed split data not found
TAM: India SS fastener/washer market size data not found; global CCL market for PCB materials large and import-dependent in India
PL_Top3_Contributors: Volume growth and better realisations in SS washers/fasteners; value-added solar frames and export mix; nickel/SS scrap price swings on ~5% net margin

BusinessModel: Happy Forgings forges and machines crankshafts, axle components and engine parts for trucks, tractors and industrial machines. It sells to vehicle makers and tier-1 suppliers in India and abroad.
RevenueStreams: Axle and engine components ~40% of revenue (FY25); commercial vehicles, farm equipment, off-highway dominate; passenger vehicles 5-6% (FY25) targeted 7.5-8%; e-axle export order from FY25; FY25 revenue ~Rs 1,409 crore
Expenses: Steel forging input dominates cost base; detailed split data not found
TAM: India forging industry plus heavy forgings (wind, defence, capital goods) entry pool; exact TAM data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: CV and tractor demand cycles driving crankshaft/axle volumes (~40% of revenue); margin discipline (EBITDA 28.6% Q3 FY25); new legs - PV parts, e-axle exports, Rs 1,200 crore heavy forgings capex FY25-27

BusinessModel: J.G. Chemicals makes zinc oxide powder used in tyres, ceramics, cosmetics and pharma. It ranks as India's largest zinc-oxide maker by volume and revenue and sells to tyre makers and other industries.
RevenueStreams: Rubber/tyre grades largest share; non-rubber grades (ceramics, cosmetics, pharma, agrochem) growing; FY25 revenue ~Rs 848 crore
Expenses: Zinc metal (hind) raw material dominates; detailed split data not found
TAM: India zinc oxide market size data not found; import-substitution headroom in non-rubber grades per company presentation
PL_Top3_Contributors: Tyre industry demand for rubber-grade zinc oxide; zinc raw material price spread; volume growth from new Dahej capacity and non-rubber expansion

Company: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited
BusinessModel: KRN makes fin-and-tube and microchannel heat exchangers that go inside air conditioners and refrigerators. It sells coils to OEMs like Daikin, Blue Star, Lloyd and Emerson plus growing exports.
RevenueStreams: Fin-and-tube heat exchangers for AC/refrigeration OEMs dominant; exports FY25 - UAE 51.7%, Canada 20.3%, Italy 14.6% (of exports), overseas later ~21% of sales; FY25 PAT Rs 71.31 crore
Expenses: Aluminium and copper tube/fin stock dominates raw material costs; detailed split data not found
TAM: Global heat exchanger market ~USD 330 billion (company-cited industry report)
PL_Top3_Contributors: AC/refrigeration OEM demand (Daikin, Blue Star, Lloyd, Emerson); microchannel facility ramp backing 5-6x three-year guidance; export mix crossing ~20% of sales

BusinessModel: ACME Solar builds and operates solar and wind power plants and sells electricity under long-term contracts. It also runs an in-house EPC arm and battery energy storage (BESS) projects.
RevenueStreams: Power generation from ~6,970 MW solar/wind portfolio (EBITDA margin 88-89%); BESS ~82% margin; standalone EPC revenue Rs 876 crore (H1 FY25); FY25 revenue Rs 1,575 crore
Expenses: Depreciation and finance costs dominate IPP accounts; EPC construction costs in EPC arm; detailed split data not found
TAM: India targets 500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030; solar plus storage forms bulk of addressable pipeline
PL_Top3_Contributors: Capacity commissioning (~102% growth FY25) lifting contracted generation; high-margin renewable and BESS EBITDA; finance costs and depreciation as swing factors

BusinessModel: Azad machines ultra-precise metal parts - blades, nozzles, fasteners - for aerospace, defence, gas turbines and nuclear plants. It exports to 12 countries with a zero-defect record to global OEMs.
RevenueStreams: Exports ~90%+ of revenue; aerospace & defence ~19% of revenue Q1 FY25 (from ~9% FY23); energy turbines dominate order book (~Rs 3,500 crore of ~Rs 6,000 crore mid-2025); FY25 revenue ~Rs 590-638 crore
Expenses: Exotic super-alloy raw materials and skilled machining labour; detailed split data not found
TAM: Global aerospace & defence and gas-turbine precision component supply chains; exact TAM data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: A&D revenue ramp (~19% of Q1 FY25 revenue, +26% YoY later); order-book execution (~Rs 6,000 crore, ~10x revenue); design-led manufacturing growth (Q1 FY25 profit +448%)

BusinessModel: Entero distributes medicines and healthcare products from pharma companies to pharmacies, hospitals and clinics across India. It runs warehouses and 3PL services and grows by acquiring regional distributors.
RevenueStreams: Pharma and consumer healthcare distribution dominant; hospital pharmacy distribution and 3PL/supply-chain services; FY25 revenue ~Rs 5,096 crore; 10 acquisitions added Rs 792 crore annualised revenue
Expenses: Cost of goods dominates; distribution/freight and employee costs key operating heads; interest on acquisition debt at net level
TAM: Indian pharma distribution market - multi-lakh-crore and fragmented, ripe for consolidation; exact size data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: Operating leverage on thin ~1.9% net margin; acquisition integration (10 deals FY25); working-capital management and interest costs

BusinessModel: GNG Electronics runs the Electronics Bazaar brand and refurbishes used laptops and desktops - buying old IT kit, repairing and certifying it, then reselling in India. It leads India in IT refurbishment.
RevenueStreams: Refurbished laptops ~76% of FY25 sales; other refurbished IT products ~24%; FY25 revenue Rs 1,411 crore; FY26 ~Rs 1,991 crore
Expenses: Cost of procuring used IT devices dominates plus refurbishment labour and logistics; detailed split data not found
TAM: India refurbished electronics market size data not found; demand from affordable computing, education digitisation, corporate IT refresh
PL_Top3_Contributors: Refurbished laptop volumes (~76% of sales); used-device procurement cost spread; other IT products (~24%) and scale economies

BusinessModel: Seshaasai prints and makes secure payment products - debit and credit cards, metal cards, QR cheques, MICR cheque books - for Indian banks, plus RFID smart cards and tags and insurance documents.
RevenueStreams: Payment cards dominant (31.9% India card issuance share FY25); banking instruments - encrypted QR cheques and MICR cheques; RFID tags/IoT and deliverables management; FY25 revenue ~Rs 1,463 crore
Expenses: PVC/metal card blanks, chips and printing consumables plus freight; detailed split data not found
TAM: India payment-card issuance market - company already at 31.9% share FY25; growth via premium metal cards, RFID/IoT tags
PL_Top3_Contributors: Debit-card issuance volumes (~91% of card growth); premium metal/high-tech card mix; new RFID/IoT and fulfilment legs offsetting cheque decline
